method: Representative implementation files were inspected from local shallow clones under /tmp/token-leads-20260629. README-only claims were excluded as decision evidence; benchmark/reproduction status is not asserted unless benchmark artifacts were inspected.

behavior_excerpts.excerpt: Console scripts expose total-agent-memory/tam MCP entrypoints and tam-lookup/lookup-memory; package data includes src sidecars so the wrapper can find src/server.py.

Store initializes SQLite WAL memory.db plus Chroma/embedding collections when available; MCP list_tools defines memory_recall, memory_save, memory_get, update/history/export/relation/tag and many higher-level memory tools.
memory_recall runs recall.search, optional enrichment and graph expansion, then applies progressive disclosure transforms for mode=index or mode=timeline.
save_knowledge creates an outbox intent, redacts private/secret content, optionally filters noisy CLI output, normalizes tags, applies quality/dedup logic, and invalidates caches on write.
tam-lookup opens the configured memory.db and searches FTS5 BM25 when present, falling back to LIKE, with JSON or bullet output.
PostToolUse hook tracks writes/edits/Bash/memory_save counts and emits MEMORY_NUDGE lines; deferred observation capture is opt-in via MEMORY_POST_TOOL_CAPTURE=1.
UserPromptSubmit hook caches JSON stdin and asynchronously saves prompt intents to memory.db when it exists, swallowing hook errors.
Creates an MCP stdio server and registers list_repos, get_graph, search_concepts, and find_graph_for_repo as JSON-returning tools.
Loads registry.json and stats.json with 60s in-process TTL cache; registry 5xx can fall back to stale cache.
fetchGraph enforces HTTPS and rejects localhost/internal/private literal hosts before fetching graph_url.
Default concept search reads precomputed stats.json and caps matches/samples; id-scoped mode searches one graph; stats failures fall back to a five-entry fan-out.
Ajv validates registry and per-format graph schemas, checks duplicate ids, retries network failures, and rejects oversized graph bodies.
Sync updates each entry status by fetching graph_url, enforcing body limits, validating schema, deriving hashes/stats, and marking missing/invalid/oversize/transient states.
CLI add flow detects repo id and graph files/formats, then prints a registry entry or opens issue/PR flows; it does not generate a local graph itself.
Global --json, --tokens, --compact, and --db flags plus commands for index, outline, search, refs, callees, impact, context, trace, deps, watch, init, ide/install, serve, and rag.
Resolves DB path from CLI/env/config/project root, refuses fresh index creation without config/existing DB/CARTOG_AUTO_INIT for write commands, then dispatches serve to MCP.
Indexer walks candidates, detects language, reuses per-thread tree-sitter extractors, computes hashes/Merkle data, redacts symbol fields when configured, and writes only changed files.
MCP compact mode defaults on, dropping heavy symbol fields and bounding rag_search bodies; response helpers cap output bytes and add narrowing hints when truncated.
cartog_rag_search uses hybrid FTS/vector search with snippet output; cartog_context fuses semantic seeds, one-hop neighbors, central symbols, and budgeted bodies.
DB search escapes LIKE wildcards, ranks exact/prefix/substring matches and definitions ahead of variables/imports, and supports refs/callees/trace/impact query families.
SessionStart hook surfaces previous background errors, runs incremental cartog index in foreground, and backgrounds RAG setup/index/update work.
Package installs codegraph CLI and codegraph-mcp console scripts; optional extras cover MCP, Python parser, watch, benchmark, analysis, docs, semantic, and transcription features.
Typer CLI supports init, clone, index, query, wipe, stats, export, benchmark, hooks/install; index can run incremental --since/--update modes and auto-export/analyze/benchmark unless suppressed.
FastMCP server lazily opens Neo4j driver, uses READ_ACCESS sessions for read tools, validates interpolated limit/depth values, and exposes schema/package/class/function/call graph tools.
TS/TSX parser extracts framework-aware nodes/edges for classes/functions/interfaces, NestJS decorators/endpoints, TypeORM columns, GraphQL operations, React hooks/components, and REST URLs.
Optional Python parser emits the same ParseResult shape for files/classes/functions/methods/imports/decorators/routes and fails with a clear [python] extra error when unavailable.
Neo4j loader creates uniqueness constraints and indexes, supports full/scoped wipe, and batches MERGE operations for graph nodes/relationships.
Git hooks append marked post-commit/post-checkout sections that run incremental codegraph index commands via a detected safe Python interpreter.
